decision: Hold this latch design for production; current evidence does not justify a finished-product or reliable-return claim
meaning: This recorded assessment and finite screens are complete. The entire CAD,simulation and product task remains incomplete.
reason: Loaded guide friction can exceed the earlier spring preload. No tested spring among300 meets all chosen loaded return and3N pull criteria at assumed friction0.1or above. This is conditional evidence,not a measured product failure.
do_not_propagate: Do not promote two-sizeV17 pilots into a final six-size product merely because unloaded motion and component mesh checks pass.
next_dependency_order: Measure pin pull and return with actual spring and guides under unloaded and reviewed transverse loads;record drag and repeatability
Measure actual spring rate,set,end seating and lateral stability;calibrate friction and guide compliance
Agree functional load and actuation requirements using voluntary handling feedback,then compare changed latch architectures if necessary
Use qualified grades and fasteners to solve coupled3D joint and worn-pad contact and correlate with bench measurements
Measure Sony mount before modifying its carrier;then compare physical fit,pressure,acoustics and ANC
Run physical comfort,heat,cleaning,drop,cycle and ageing tests;obtain production quotes before any sales or superiority claim
